Reservation in India.fact: == Exclusions == In the reservation system in India, the central government notifies castes as SC, ST, or OBC categories based on socio-historical background, while exclusion from reservation benefits is determined by an individual's socio-economic status, nativeness, and religion.  For SC and ST individuals, pre-exclusion criteria are employed, while post-exclusion criteria are used for OBCs.  For ST individuals, the following categories are not entitled to benefit from the reservation system: Immigration from a Scheduled State/UT to a non-Scheduled State/UT.  For SC individuals, the following categories are not entitled to benefit from the reservation system: Immigration from a Scheduled State/UT to a non-Scheduled State/UT.  Professing religions other than Hinduism, Buddhism, and Sikhism. Children of civil servants in high positions
